sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN member_id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN member_id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer:
在 2026 年 8 月（2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31）期间，青禾的各项消费及频次指标如下：
- 有效订单均额：37.15 元/单（计算口径为净销售额除以有效订单数）
- 购买会员人均消费：66.87 元/账户（计算口径为净销售额除以购买会员账户数）
- 购买频次：1.80 单/账户（计算口径为有效订单数除以购买会员账户数）
